caption: The drawing depicts a two-piece outfit and a hat. The outfit consists of a long-sleeved jacket and a matching full-length skirt. Both the jacket and skirt are made of a greyish fabric with a subtle cross-hatch pattern and feature prominent black vertical and horizontal lines as trim, which run down the front of the jacket and vertically down the skirt. The jacket has black cuffs and a black collar. To the upper left of the outfit, there is a medium-brimmed straw hat with a wide, red hatband and large red decorative bows or ribbons. The background is a plain beige color, and there are no visible body parts, as the outfit is presented without a figure. Near the bottom left corner, there is a handwritten signature and date: "L. Adamelli July 13th, 1931."
title: Doll's Suit and Hat
